## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New sensor / control
- [ ] Register map or documentation

## Checklist

- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] `pytest` passes, and new behaviour has tests
- [ ] User-facing text is in `translations/en.json` **and** `translations/nl.json`
- [ ] README / `docs/` updated where needed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under *Unreleased*
- [ ] No vendor documents, serial numbers, IP addresses or other personal data are included

## Tested on a real device?

- [ ] No (please explain why it is safe)
